original_test_intent: Demonstrate that OAM_0 sensor population and readings are healthy and mutually consistent across SMC Redfish, IPMI, ROCm and BMC Web.
original_method: Capture all four views in one bounded interval, map each OAM_0 sensor across naming schemes, normalize units/status, and compare values using owner-approved tolerance and freshness rules.
manual_activity: Thermal/GPU owner approves OAM_0 crosswalk, tolerances and sensor semantics, checks Web evidence and decides disposition.

agent_execution_scope: Normalize names, units, status and time

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce one row per physical OAM_0 sensor with four source names, raw/normalized value, unit, health, capture time, delta and disposition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a concrete reconciliation model while retaining every original observation plane.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Static inventory, workload response and neighboring OAMs are explicitly outside this checkpoint.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Natural sensor movement requires bounded skew and tolerance; equality of asynchronously sampled raw numbers is not a valid universal oracle.

project_override_considerations: Engineering must define which IPMI and ROCm readings truly represent each OAM_0 Redfish sensor and whether Web values are rounded or delayed.
expected_evidence: OAM_0 identity and approved four-source crosswalk
Tool/BMC/driver versions and synchronized clock evidence
Logs, anomalies, credential cleanup and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently requires multi-source OAM_0 sensor and Web comparison; DeepSeek is incomplete historical advice rather than an alternate authoritative intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Crosswalk, tools and confirmation are ordinary project prerequisites and do not make this case inherently blocked.

review_improvement: Restores the omitted IPMI and ROCm paths and defines a time-aware four-plane OAM_0 sensor comparison.
independent_technical_reasoning: Sensor names and update rates differ by interface: an IPMI label can be truncated, ROCm may expose GPU-local junction temperature, and Web may round a Redfish value. A physical-sensor crosswalk and capture-time window are therefore prerequisites to meaningful deltas. Re-running until values coincide would hide timing or cache defects, so mismatch evidence must be retained on the first valid synchronized capture.
